### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f727061b88258b946402bbb29afee6e6410081d6` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `73480216a52dcebe3be394ff8fb238de715ccca4` — the merge of head `8820dc39afc6787479be869b975f5a64153b7f69` into base `f727061b88258b946402bbb29afee6e6410081d6`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 73480216a52dcebe3be394ff8fb238de715ccca4 && git checkout 73480216a52dcebe3be394ff8fb238de715ccca4
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f727061b88258b946402bbb29afee6e6410081d6 8820dc39afc6787479be869b975f5a64153b7f69 && git checkout -B drift-repro f727061b88258b946402bbb29afee6e6410081d6 && git merge --no-ff 8820dc39afc6787479be869b975f5a64153b7f69

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f727061b88258b946402bbb29afee6e6410081d6
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在"应用构建"首页，每个包的卡片多了一个"管理"按钮，点一下就能停用或重新启用这个包；标题旁多一个"全部包"链接，打开完整的包列表。
- 为什么做：以前要先进某个包、再打开顶部切换器、再点最后一项才能找到"停用"，管理员常常找不到。
- 出错会怎样：能不能停用仍由服务器判断，按钮只是打开原有的同一个管理面板；设置菜单里不新增条目，仍按你之前的裁决。
- 要你做什么：无。区域在测试全绿后自行落地。

## 席位核对

**L1-a: ACCEPT** · head `9428e59ab208c000486dd5d8875cb5688db42f19` · Fixes #35196 (route C under ruling 甲 of #25098) · 2026-11-19T13:29Z

Readings: K=14 (under 15, no main merge owed); `check-governed-merges --pr 35516` not governed; `merge-tree` against main clean. CI was still running at review time: 10 success, 10 skipped, 25 in progress, 0 failed. pkg-2 lands on full green and marks the draft ready.

**Code (8 files, +438/−135).**
- `PackageSwitcher.tsx`: `fetchFullPackage` is hoisted to the exported `fetchInstalledPackageRow`. It is moved verbatim, with the `res.ok` decision (objectui#7881) and the `userMessage`-over-`message` read (objectui#7938) intact. The switcher keeps calling it, so the two doors open the sheet on the same record.
- `BuilderLanding.tsx`:
  - Every card (installed apps and the author's own) gains **Manage**. It reads the full row and opens the existing `PackageDetailSheet`, whose Disable / Enable verdicts stay the server's `disableable` / status.
  - A missing row gives a toast and opens no sheet. A failed read gives the formatted error.
  - After a lifecycle action, the cards and the sheet's record are re-read. A failed re-read closes the sheet rather than leaving the pre-action verb on screen, which is the switcher's posture.
  - The title row links **All packages** to `packagesHref('/apps/setup')`, the unfiltered `developer:packages` component route. It is a link from Studio, not a Setup menu entry, so ruling 甲 (no unfiltered Setup entry) holds. The page is hosted at the Setup app's address because that app is the one every boot loads, as the constant's docblock says.
- `setup-nav.contributions.ts` and `setup-packages-door.test.ts` change comments only: they say where the served door now is. The pins are unchanged, so no Setup `nav_packages` exists and the declared Studio app still ships Overview → Packages.
- `en` / `zh` gain the new labels.

**Pins.** `BuilderLanding.packagesDoor-35196.test.tsx`, 5 cases:
- a disableable code-loaded module opens a sheet with Disable;
- CONTROL: a read-only app the door refuses has no Disable;
- a disabled package shows Enable;
- every card carries Manage, the author's own included;
- the All packages link targets the unfiltered page.

The ablation turns 4 of them red (7010531329). Browser readings B1–B3 before the change are on #35196 (7008882599).

**Declaration: agreed.** `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` / `@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/i18n` patch. It adds a UI door onto existing server verdicts, with no API or schema surface. The `platform-objects` hunks are comment-only and publish no behaviour.

**Routing.** Not governed, no contract face: pkg-2 lands it on green CI. A new push needs a fresh L1 only if it changes more than a main merge.
